items.q: 就业降温后，10 年期会否在 10/9 前回落到 5.2% 以下？
items.q_en: After cooling jobs, does the 10-year fall below 5.2% by 10/9?
items.expect: 若就业降温成立，10/5–10/9 至少有一个交易日 10 年期收于 5.2% 以下；若一直高于 5.2%，说明长端由期限溢价而非加息预期驱动。
items.expect_en: If cooling jobs hold, the 10-year closes below 5.2% on at least one session 10/5–10/9; if it stays above, the long end is driven by term premium rather than hike odds.
items.falsifier: 10/5–10/9 每个交易日都收于 5.2% 以上。

items.q: 东芝扩产对存储股是一次性冲击还是结构性重估？
items.q_en: Is Toshiba's expansion a one-off or a structural reset for storage?
items.expect: 结构性：希捷和西部数据 10/9 收盘都仍低于 10/1 收盘（945.57 / 462.56）。若两者都收复，则是一次性冲击。
items.expect_en: Structural: Seagate and Western Digital both still close below their 10/1 closes (945.57 / 462.56) on 10/9. If both recover, it was one-off.
items.falsifier: 两者 10/9 收盘都高于 10/1 收盘。
items.falsifier_en: Both close above their 10/1 closes on 10/9.

items.q: A股 CPO 10/8 复市：按"被政策点名 vs 未点名"拆分后会怎样？
items.q_en: A-share CPO reopens 10/8: how do named versus un-named names behave?
items.expect: 吸取 9/28 的教训：若休市期间没有新的针对性利空，未被点名的天孚通信、光迅科技 10/8 等权为正；被点名的中际旭创、新易盛相对另两家跑输。
items.expect_en: Applying the 9/28 lesson: absent new targeted news during the break, the un-named TFC and Accelink are positive EW on 10/8, and the named Innolight and Eoptolink underperform them.
items.falsifier: 未点名两家 10/8 等权 ≤ 0，或被点名两家跑赢另两家。
items.falsifier_en: Un-named pair EW ≤ 0 on 10/8, or the named pair outperforms.
